assets.name: tree-bark.png
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: seamless square albedo/base-color texture for mature oak tree trunks in a colourful whimsical medieval 3D fantasy game for adults.
Primary request: weathered mature oak bark with long irregular vertical ridges and narrow branching cracks, broken knobbly plates and tactile deep grain. Warm grey-umber bark, gentle muted brown variations, small rich moss-green patches tucked into cracks. Dense convincing small-scale bark detail, hand-crafted stylized character, quietly magical woodland material without symbols or ornament.
Style/medium: premium painterly 3D digital fantasy game material, physically plausible texture color with restrained stylization, not a photograph.
Composition/framing: square seamless tile, perfectly flat front-on albedo swatch. Bark ridges oriented vertically from top edge to bottom edge. Uniform scale across the image, no central focal point, all four edges must repeat seamlessly.
Lighting: evenly lit diffuse albedo only, no directional light, no specular glints, no baked cast shadows, no dark vignette, no ambient shading gradient.
Avoid: entire tree trunks, branches, leaves, sky, landscape, faces, knots shaped as eyes, objects, text, watermarks, logos, photo texture scan look.
assets.notes: Visually inspected for subject, colour, coverage and unwanted objects. Seamless tiling requested; exact edge continuity not measured.

assets.name: tree-leaves.png
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: seamless square foliage surface albedo texture to wrap over solid 3D tree canopy meshes in a colourful whimsical medieval fantasy game for adults.
Primary request: a continuous dense canopy surface made of many overlapping medium-small oak and beech leaves, filling every part of the frame. Varied organic leaf shapes: gently lobed oak leaves and smooth pointed oval beech leaves, fine stems and subtly painted veins. Rich dark forest green, olive green and moss green, with only a few warm golden leaves scattered among the greens. Dense small-scale detail, believable leafy forms, controlled color variation and a cohesive softly painted fantasy feel.
Style/medium: premium painterly 3D digital game texture; visibly hand-painted shapes and softly simplified material detail, never photorealistic or a photograph.
Composition/framing: square seamless repeat on all four edges, flat orthographic surface viewed straight-on, uniform dense coverage and scale. The leaves overlap edge-to-edge across the whole image. No holes or sky visible anywhere, no central focal subject, no branches.
Lighting: flat diffuse albedo-only color, leaf volume suggested with gentle local color shifts, no baked cast shadows, no hard highlights, no directional lighting, no vignette.
Avoid: whole tree silhouette, branches, large twigs, sky, transparent gaps, flowers, fruit, insects, people, landscapes, text, lettering, logos, watermarks.
assets.notes: Visually inspected for subject, colour, coverage and unwanted objects. Seamless tiling requested; exact edge continuity not measured.
